方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
高朋滿座#172粵
programme.desc: 義發現三妗婆強拉花與別人「相睇」，相親對象是「頭油阿叔」阿華。義在家中說出此事，令眾人擔心花的終生幸福。喜到廟內拜神時，得悉花並非三妗婆的親生女兒；眾人都擔心這名養母會出賣「女兒」的終生幸福。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#17粵普PG
programme.desc: 歐陽鋒懷疑郭靖給的是假的《九陰真經》，黃蓉聲稱能替他翻譯，要求一餐換翻譯一頁經文；周伯通突然空降船上救走黃蓉等人後就來到牛家村，在酒館內發現傻姑，而傻姑竟然會桃花島的武功，而後在密室發現曲靈風的屍骨…

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
食平3D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽用水果入饌出神入化，由教切大樹菠蘿講起，用豬尾骨、蜜棗、陳皮烹調「大樹菠蘿湯」；又買來紅毛榴槤炮製雪糕。她以韓式調味料開芡煮牛肋條，事前選用雪梨蓉來醃，有何功用？還有一道用木煙熏的「豉油王熏雞」。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 眼睛是敏感及相對脆弱的器官，如有血漿、脂質或蛋白質等液體從血管滲漏，並積聚在視網膜下方，或會導致「滲出性視網膜炎」，如何檢測？治療方面，眼科醫生建議先觀察，再考慮修補漏血管及消除積水。適量的中高強度運動有助柏金遜症患者改善平衡力，以至延緩病情。相關團體還成立乒乓球隊，讓「柏友」藉此提高手眼協調性及反應能力。團體代表偕隊長同來，分享得着及深刻點滴。「睇餸食飯」環節，傅季馨示範「意式白酒水瓜子燴雞」。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃港深珠粵
programme.desc: 來到網紅追捧的珠海文化區，享用擺盤精緻的花花主題套餐，閨密們打卡慶生好去處！深圳熱賣椰子雞火鍋，鮮味雞件與清甜椰青湯底可謂絕配；臘味煲仔飯也是暖胃之選。超市有售雪藏貓山王果肉、榴槤薄餅，榴槤控為你「試伏」。回港搜羅「吃貨」優惠情報，日式居酒屋的蟹宴二人餐可嚐盡松葉蟹、皇帝蟹、鱈場蟹滋味，甲羅燒釜飯更是啖啖蟹膏，勁滿足！鬧市中隱藏「森系玻璃屋」，特色套餐匯聚十道亞洲風味，讓人在田園氛圍下忙裡偷閒。

programme.title: 天梯#3粵
programme.desc: 鄭嬌因出手打世豪被捕，世豪傷勢惡化，鄭嬌再次被扣留，苗天成功要脅坤堯放過鄭嬌。世章欲揭發坤堯所做不法之事，卻被坤堯輕易脫身，坤堯反指世章不尊重他，聲言要請假十天。苗天與鄭嬌發現所有藥材均發霉。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 時下流行穿熱褲，丸尾媽媽其實一直嚮往穿熱褲，但在家中試穿時卻被丸尾看到，後者大感震驚。爺爺打算丟掉沒用的舊物，小丸子助他分類後，爺爺卻表示不捨得丟，嫲嫲指出舊物是打開記憶的鎖匙。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 兒童體適能教練主理「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，小朋友準備好了嗎？雙腳踏穩，用手指做訓練。左手「L」字，右手「1」字，雙手不停互換；試試做「雙V」手勢並併合成「W」字，再分開雙手做出「L」字，可考驗協調度與全身肌力。再進一步，連雙腳都要跟着指令做！運用膠紙在地上貼一條直線，沿着線向前行之餘，再先後做出「開合跳」、「側身踏步」、「交叉跳」、「跳躍後蹲下」的動作，是一套講求心肺及協調能力的鍛練。

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 花騎士・真誠的出現，令公主意識到愛麗絲比亞有新的敵人。到底新敵人是何方神聖？懷著什麼目的？公主們都百思不得其解。適逢今天是奈津的演唱會，這個大家等待已久的盛事，終究也避不過敵人的魔爪。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
programme.desc: 香港人頭腦靈活，經常有創新意念，事實上香港有很多不出名的發明，亦有很多不出名的發明家，當中有幾多會成功呢？新聞掏寶和大家重溫2004年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
滙豐Premier Elite呈獻：《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》粵
programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 東張西望粵 及 2026香港小姐 敢．至完美粵
programme.desc: 兩家小孩疑因使用商場玩樂設施起爭執，雙方家長繼而爆發衝突，涉事老婦更推撞及掌摑女童！攝製隊向目擊者探問當時情況，並街訪市民的看法。假冒「拳王」的渣男被多任前度指控欺騙感情與金錢，還曾出軌、召妓、感染淋病。渣男亦自稱是電競選手，節目組向內地電競俱樂部查證，揭破男子大話連篇！女事主隨外景主持登門對質，找到渣男母親對話，其後更接到渣男承諾分期歸還款項的短訊？男士步入中年，腎功能開始退化，有何保健方法？

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#14粵
programme.desc: 嘉冰認出電視台歌唱比賽「當年好聲音」上屆冠軍原是其手下敗將，她當年曾勝出業餘歌唱比賽，因父親反對未能投身歌壇。另一方面，萬里不滿嘉冰蠶食其生活，再度設法逼她離開。萬里的舊客戴志昌轉投楊帆旗下，贊助新一屆「當年好聲音」，打算安排冠軍唱出其廣告歌，卻不滿楊帆提交的歌曲。萬里獲安排協助宣傳，伺機奪回志昌這位大客……萬里設法誘嘉冰返回加拿大，卻觸及其傷心事，令她負氣離去。最終，嘉冰回來宣佈一個驚人決定……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#19粵
programme.desc: 曉彤成功使啟榮批准家謙加入渡假村小組。幸如等人與浩恩拍攝家電廣告，熙妍看着浩恩、幸如互動感不是味兒。熙妍得知幸如、浩恩被惡霸擄走，焦急帶人營救……啟榮、哲朗忌憚曉彤、家謙聯盟，哲朗吩咐助手Edmond找出曉彤的黑材料。繼威等人籌備新廣告，繼威被青春模特兒Emma吸引，雪文妒忌。雪文與佩貞的婆媳糾紛愈演愈烈，繼威煩惱不已。這時繼威與Emma不期而遇，似乎對上了眼……

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#24粵普
programme.desc: 蜜語調職到銷售部後，沒有發揮機會；寄舟畫展在香港洽談期間出現問題，蜜語趁機遊說他在浦榮舉辦，紀封由反對到支持舉辦畫展；錢迅趁機想要除去紀封；一切本來安排得非常妥當，展出前蜜語發現最重要的主展品不見了…

programme.title: 森下仁丹Bifina Slim益生菌呈獻：南美潮什麼2粵
programme.desc: 來到哥國卡塔赫納附近小鎮，不可錯過托圖莫火山泥漿浴，還有專人按摩服務，好歎！被納入世遺的卡塔赫納舊城區，保留了殖民時期建築與城牆古蹟，舊式住宅大門還裝有不同動物門環，象徵甚麼意思？小社區搖身一變藝術蒲點，街頭壁畫隨處可見，打卡一流！遊沿海城市必嚐鮮，先試平民熱捧炸魚，再吃醃魚料理、海鮮燴飯。芷珮也慕名到咖啡店，品味冠軍級咖啡，有手信可將咖啡搽上身？登上「海盜船」出海吹風，在夕陽映照下享受悠閒時光！

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
再創世紀#32粵PG
programme.desc: 明晞與澤雨到德國公幹，澤雨提議明晞放假，並帶她遊覽布拉格。澤雨在歌劇院門外巧遇定垚，二人重拾當日感覺，相約同遊時，卻被明晞暗中破壞。天生保釋回家，高哲預感天生及啟堂會有所動作，果然對方比他們早一步召開超級電池記者會，並命名為「烏托邦計劃」，程凱氣憤指責二人偷去他的設計概念。明晞被蒙在鼓裡，對天生失望。天生感到明晞與澤雨有曖昧，夫妻攤牌。天生邀請天蔭加入烏托邦計劃，澤雨拒絕，天生的一番話卻令他動搖。

programme.desc: 鄭嬌因出手打世豪被捕，世豪傷勢惡化，鄭嬌再次被扣留，苗天成功要脅坤堯放過鄭嬌。世章欲揭發坤堯所做不法之事，卻被坤堯輕易脫身，坤堯反指世章不尊重他，聲言要請假十天。苗天與鄭嬌發現所有藥材均發霉。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#172粵
programme.desc: 義發現三妗婆強拉花與別人「相睇」，相親對象是「頭油阿叔」阿華。義在家中說出此事，令眾人擔心花的終生幸福。喜到廟內拜神時，得悉花並非三妗婆的親生女兒；眾人都擔心這名養母會出賣「女兒」的終生幸福。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#17粵普PG
programme.desc: 歐陽鋒懷疑郭靖給的是假的《九陰真經》，黃蓉聲稱能替他翻譯，要求一餐換翻譯一頁經文；周伯通突然空降船上救走黃蓉等人後就來到牛家村，在酒館內發現傻姑，而傻姑竟然會桃花島的武功，而後在密室發現曲靈風的屍骨…

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 「巨聲幫」林欣彤、陳慧敏決戰「兄弟幫」范振鋒、林盛斌。在波爾多，馬球有新玩法，猜猜會以甚麼取代馬匹？Do姐大方讓眾人提問，卻被阿范氣得呼其「鋒哥」，究竟發生何事？鄺潔楹帶大家參觀東京特色酒店，房內的蛋形物件大有用途！去旅行，當然要認識當地文化，法國人喝酒時有指定動作，關乎會否「行衰運」！兩位兄弟在答題板以「Jump」代「斟」，搞乜東東？兌換環節，慧敏賽前曾得方力申提供「貼士」，可會信錯人？

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 黃翠如與陸浩明（6號）接受Do姐的問題大考驗，6號於看片前還拿「肥媽」來創作口號，現場反應卻不似預期。韓國的濟州盛產綠茶，在火山爆發形成的洞穴咖啡店內，還有特別的綠茶體驗？曼谷的非一般停車位，有何條件方能使用？周星馳的電影告訴大家，不可單憑外表判斷物品的用途。「問題專員」鄺潔楹在東京找來幾可亂真的「煙肉露筍卷」，其「真身」是……有嘉賓的二千積分最終價值不足一港元，到底兌換期間發生了甚麼事？

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
高朋滿座#173粵
programme.desc: 花潛入義房，找出舞會當天所穿舞衣，懷念二人共舞。花驚見同事Betty與藥房員工墮入愛河，更得知是女方主動追求，因此啟發了花。可是花到高家吃飯時，得知義心藏「夢中女神」程家敏的消息，使花打消向有義示愛。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#18粵普PG
programme.desc: 郭靖在皇宮阻止完顏洪烈等人盜取《武穆遺書》期間，被楊康用匕首刺傷，黃蓉帶著郭靖躲到密室療傷。完顏洪烈發現取得的是空盒，歐陽鋒等人又返回皇宮尋找。陸冠英與程瑤迦不約而同來到客店找郭靖，卻遇到侯通海等人…

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌 之 森田面膜咁敷至完美粵
食平3D粵
programme.desc: 林子博、容羨媛帶同子女到訪，菜式以老少咸宜為主。香蕉朱古力西多、酥皮肉卷均迎合小朋友口味，而一道「冬菇冬筍燜乳鴿」竟令兩歲小女孩食到筍不離手？還有補肺的金銀菜煲豬肺湯、原隻八寶芝士蒸南瓜和豬頸肉雞煲。

programme.title: 滙豐Premier Elite呈獻：《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》粵
programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 學者指黑眼圈可分為四大類型，並詳述有關特徵與改善建議。除了睡眠不足外，嘉賓也提到鼻敏感、經常揉眼睛等都有機會導致黑眼圈。長者退休後需面對生活轉變，容易影響心理健康。心理治療師提醒老友記要接納身體機能退化為自然生理現象，並多與親友溝通，保持樂觀心態。跟家人和睦相處有技巧，他強調互相體諒是關鍵，亦鼓勵長者積極學習新事物、培養興趣，以正面態度迎接人生下半場。「睇餸食飯」，Annie師傅示範「柚子醬鴨」。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃港深珠粵
programme.desc: 由深圳灣口岸過關，在前海寶安區摩天輪附近打卡後，是時候飲杯茶、吃個甜點唞一唞，何解喝杯玫瑰茶卻似飲啤酒？轉往珠海，坐三分鐘纜車上石景山飽覽完風景，下山竟不用兩分鐘？原來是坐車沿滑道快速落山，超怡略嫌未夠喉！主持在珠海還一試高質實力派粵菜，以及酒店按摩。香港的吃貨優惠未夠貼地？這集有茶餐廳小菜套餐推介，縱是茶記卻可吃到菜膽雞與避風塘炒蝦？同枱附送招牌酥皮蛋撻！另到銅鑼灣品嚐鐵板燒餐廳的隱藏餐單。

programme.title: 天梯#4粵
programme.desc: 世章提出只要苗天寫一個「欠」字，便即付三千元給他們。苗天向村民派發利錢，發現田愛娣的姑娘在拜祭父母。苗天陪鄭嬌拜祭亡妻，遇鍾鑑帶愛娣看墳地，更替她要求減價。愛娣下車後發現世章等她，還送了她珍珠項鏈。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 學校檢查學生有否剪指甲，小丸子等人忘了剪，丸尾恐嚇他們晚上剪指甲會見不到父母最後一面。某家人種的繡球花開得很美，媽媽說花是粉紅色，爸爸卻說是水藍色，媽媽聽後不知何故有點慍怒。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 大家有沒有想過擁有一個專屬的夢幻城堡？這次「Artspiration」，子健哥哥會指導各位如何利用簡單的紙和筆，一步步畫出心目中的魔幻城堡。隨後，他與玲玲姐姐還會為各自的城堡塗上顏色，讓作品變得更色彩繽紛。隨着暑假踏入尾聲，本集「開心SHARE」邀請小朋友投稿分享「放假我最喜歡去的地方」。有孩子喜歡於假期時跟家人到沙灘嬉戲，這也勾起了Tiffany姐姐兒時與家人，在沙灘埋下時光錦囊的溫馨回憶。

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 正當阿燎準備還書，大家都說想見識一下愛麗絲比亞的中央圖書館，於是與阿燎一同前往。在圖書館，大家偶遇風花堇師姐，原來她會定期來到圖書館，為愛麗絲族講故事。可是在閒談之間，阿堇竟露出不悅之色。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌 之 森田面膜咁敷至完美粵
programme.desc: 長沙灣一房不足250平方呎，但樓底夠高，設計師利用拼色突出北歐田園主題，效果如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵 及 2026香港小姐 敢．至完美粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#15粵
programme.desc: 嘉冰決定參加「當年好聲音」，並與萬里打賭，若成功通過海選，萬里便不可再逼她離開。因戴志昌贊助節目，萬里等人參與籌辦海選工作；楊帆則忙於籌備廣告歌，分身乏術。萬里特意安排三名友人與嘉冰同組參賽，希望阻止她入選。另一邊廂，嘉冰為爭一口氣而積極備戰，吃盡苦頭……海選當天，擔任評判的楊帆得知萬里有親人參賽，揚言決不放水。萬里察覺嘉冰似有不妥，更無意中得知她回港的真正原因。臨出場前，嘉冰竟萌生退意……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#20粵PG
programme.desc: 幸如等人勸婉蘭與丈夫分開，但婉蘭繼續自欺欺人。幸如、熙妍發現幸如夢中經歷的不幸似乎出現在婉蘭等人身上……啟榮的太太林舒雅娘家雅爾頓集團財困，啟榮表面順從苓君的注資決定，卻密謀於雅爾頓取得權力。雪文發現繼威與Emma密會，報復女方導致其受傷；東窗事發，雪文面臨被解僱危機……家謙、幸如向啟榮匯報，啟榮異常浮躁地批評匯報內容。佩貞與雪文的生母沈淑冰爭吵，混亂間雪文誤傷佩貞，終引致雪文與繼威、佩貞鬧僵。

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#25粵普
programme.desc: 寄舟的畫不翼而飛，蜜語想到用其他畫代替便匆忙去拿。獲貞貞准許參與開幕禮的記者對寄舟處處挑釁，然而蜜語一直未將畫送回酒店；原來一切都在紀封掌握之中…事後蜜語覺得不被紀封信任而提分手，並去新西蘭洽談生意。

programme.title: 森下仁丹Bifina Slim益生菌呈獻：南美潮什麼2粵
programme.desc: 坐兩小時快艇縱橫加勒比海，住進一間浮水旅館，入覺時也可感受加勒比海的海風！旅館面積小，不妨參加遊覽團，前往附近的小島逛一逛，包括全世界人口密度最高的人工島聖克魯斯島，游水、徒手捉魚也可輕鬆玩樂一番。到訪全美洲規模最大的鳥類保育園，近距離觀賞紅鸛、鸚鵡，更有孔雀在芷珮面前開屏呢！旅程最後一站到達哥國的黑人城鎮帕淪克，鎮民娶妻要「打得」？而當地女士擅長煮食，芷珮一嚐住家炮製的椰子糖，大讚好味！

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌 之 森田面膜咁敷至完美粵
再創世紀#33粵PG
programme.desc: 澤雨告知程凱與小慧，天蔭將加入烏托邦計劃，二人感到被背叛。永廉查得烏托邦只是個泡沫，定垚想天蔭懸崖勒馬，可惜澤雨只想重振方家。有消息指烏托邦的實驗室造假，π宇宙停牌，天生及啟堂回應屈奇頓亦有意加入，令股價不跌反升，啟堂情緒高漲而心臟病發，天生冷眼旁觀。定垚對父親的死無能為力，頹廢度日，幸有澤雨守護在旁。依寧把大公司有意收購屈奇頓的消息告知敬賢，敬賢卻不感興趣，事後依寧將消息告訴投行經理，二人決裂。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 康有為、梁啟超提出戊戌變法，要學生讀通識，農夫學耕田？慈禧請來義和團對付八國聯軍，最終被火燒圓明園，王晶、游清源計算她一生的成與敗。古代靈異事件研究所所長翻查古書，借助現代高科技揭開古代靈異事件之謎！

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 中國古代有四大美人，黎芷珊訪問羞花美人楊貴妃。當年已為人妻的她為何會被老爺搶去？被唐玄宗趕出宮後，她如何憑一頭秀髮重返宮中？人稱關二哥的關羽為何得到黑白二道崇拜？綠帽、紅面、大關刀的形象又由誰人設計？

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
細味文明粵英
programme.desc: 兩座巨型火山從愛琴海冒起，繼而出現兩個壯觀島嶼：聖托里尼和米洛斯。山峰倒塌形成破火山口，令聖托里尼展現超凡地貌，一個個小鎮屹立於崖頂，而曾是海盜天堂的米洛斯島亦充滿原始美。

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 巴基斯坦的木爾坦, 南亞最古老的城市。陪伴木爾坦人穿越沙漠的駱駝對他們來說是很珍貴的存在 死後的駱駝更被製作成駱駝皮燈，再畫上傳統的納卡什圖案，為木爾坦人照亮黑暗的盡頭

programme.title: 世界獨特社區粵普
programme.desc: 越南筒房是因人口暴漲，搶奪居住空間所衍生出的獨特建築風格。房間建築空間狹長而深，巧妙避開了以橫向寬度的高稅收。丹麥社區農圃, 提供一種糧食自給, 互助和合作的生活方式, 試圖打破都市住民彼此間的隔閡。

programme.title: 胡說八道真情假期粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
programme.desc: 出埠旅行最能了解好友的真性情，「胡說八道會」六位姊妹結伴暢遊澳洲兩個星期，盡顯真我一面。準媽媽胡杏兒貪玩「唔錫身」，姚子羚對姊妹最有心！胡定欣性感又感性，李施嬅衣著品味夠獨特。胡蓓蔚說話有幾Mean？黃智雯轉數有多慢？今集逐一預覽。旅行籌備過程一波三折，智雯更於出發前鬧出「放飛機」疑雲！姊妹們抵澳後進駐景色優美的湖畔酒店，透過按摩、水療消除疲勞。智雯為杏兒悉心編排「大乳操」，眾女還即席集體演練！

programme.title: 豪遊咖啡粵
programme.desc: 主持在西貢發掘了不少精品咖啡店。Ben走進主打「Espresso Tonic」的咖啡店，一嚐融入本地元素的咖啡。來到海邊Cafe，細味美景與靚啡，Ben頓感身心舒暢。另一間咖啡店，招牌咖啡竟是以玫瑰花粉調製？Mo找到充滿歐洲氣息的咖啡店，並介紹Espresso的文化。他和太太陳茵媺相約歎咖啡，與觀眾分享夫妻之間的咖啡情緣，茵媺還會為Mo親手沖咖啡。這回咖啡之道，兩位主持互相為對方創製新口味咖啡。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 這集，谷主凱文引領大家一同了解何謂流量密碼。她指出，如想打造出爆紅現象，需滿足多項因素，現今網絡媒體的演算法就是重要一環。她以病毒來形容這種傳播模式，還嘗試分析近年多個流量密碼主題，盲盒、吃播ASMR都是其一。不過，現今潮流轉瞬即逝，大多流量密碼僅能維持3至6個月。凱文試析原因之餘，還與拍檔汛文、泳嘉討論延長流量密碼的辦法。三人更忽發奇想預測未來的流量密碼，汛文提出了一種令人意想不到的昆蟲……

programme.title: 滙豐Premier Elite呈獻：《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》粵
programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 濠玩夏水禮粵PG
programme.desc: 延續水上激鬥，這集先玩一人一字答題。電影題未問完，思霆已投降自行淋水；金剛答錯又問錯，「零常識」韻姿更自稱垃圾？團隊爬上浮床齊齊站起來，跌到燥的浩文怒問誰人設計遊戲，卻見敵隊一次成功！兩隊輪流添水入杯，水瀉出要飲重口味特飲；Bob挑戰表面張力極限，可會連累全隊受罰？用水桶隔空傳水變潑人，女隊員硬食水箭衝擊，靚樣崩壞！水上版爭櫈仔好難玩，單是坐上水泡已不簡單；可憐思霆被單挑對手無情欺負，引起公憤……

programme.title: 香港婚後事粵PG
programme.desc: 家事不宜擺上枱，但吳若希向來敢言，其實丈夫可有投訴？若希細談互相鬥嘴的婚姻相處模式，還直言擺上網是想網友幫忙教夫。夫妻生活節奏不同，要花不少時間磨合，若希亦稱最討厭丈夫為小事講大話。走過七年之癢，若希坦言多得參演了《香港人在北京》？生B後繼續發展個人事業，她既感謝丈夫支持，也希望為兩子女做個榜樣。要避免伴侶出軌，維繫關係比管制有效？若希也講述某人妻為報復丈夫，搭上他的好友後發現「外面世界很大」……

programme.title: 香港婚後事粵PG
programme.desc: 當婚姻關係無法挽回，離婚在所難免，這集請來龔慈恩探討現今女性對離婚看法。龔姐經歷過兩段婚姻，坦言若遇合適對象仍會考慮。談到子女將來成家立室，龔姐會是怎樣的奶奶、外母？家庭離異會對下一代造成傷害，離婚父母要好好處理！單親長大的天宇獲母親濃濃的愛，也和同母異父弟弟胡㻗感情深厚，唯獨介懷身高不及對方？此外，諾懿指導天宇煎牛扒，平價食材煮出貴價口感！在職媽媽總有不少辛酸，慰玲難忘拍劇時兩次遇上仔仔入醫院。

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 阿渡和阿驅打算對打練習，卻發現麒麟丸受損嚴重有待修理，阿驅把麒麟丸拆散，之後卻不懂重組回去，因而大受打擊，意志消沉。阿渡與睡不著的阿驅聊天，一句無心之言啟發後者重新創造魔神。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 嘉賓主持羅皓誼找來三位小朋友，一起跟隨兒童體適能教練的指示「WORKOUT 2GETHER」！躺在瑜伽墊上，先來一個簡單的捲腹，然後背部與腰部貼地，以核心的力量輪流讓左手碰右腳、右手碰左腳。轉坐姿，保持V-Sit，利用核心帶動身體左右轉，最後做一個側平板支撐，就完成「核心訓練」。下一節是「靜態伸展運動」，雖沒有那麼耗力，但練習時仍有一定的拉扯感覺；而肩頸、胸大肌、髖關節等部位統統可以伸展得到。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 安妮的童話粵日
programme.desc: 馬修離世三個月後，安妮成為艾凡里小學的教師，初上任即遇頑皮學生考驗。同時她與好友成立改善會，四出募集公會堂維修經費。雖屢受挫折與嘲諷，安妮仍堅持以善意面對眾人，並立志活出美麗人生。

programme.title: 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
programme.desc: 香港，一個中西薈萃、新舊共融的國際都市，不論吃喝、玩樂、購物都多姿多采。節目中主持人會介紹最新的潮流資訊和生活熱話，為你發掘香港更精彩的一面，講究生活和追求時尚的你絕對不能錯過。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 《新聞透視》，每周專題報道多段香港以至國際的矚目新聞，聚焦港人最關心的民生話題，並邀請各界人士、學者、專家，一同深入探討箇中來龍去脈。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 香港系列之細間始終你好粵
programme.desc: 觀塘市中心的重建計劃，讓豆漿店老闆夫婦萌生退休念頭，街坊的熱情卻令他們決定搬進商場重開，並堅持用高質食材，每天早起磨豆守住老味道！氣味無形，文字有形。有夫婦將兩者結合，以「文字香水」呈現人生階段，如何做到？祥師兄探店指裝潢似傢俬店，上樓梯更見有茶室配套，可讓客人以茶會友。傳統上，有事慶祝就會訂製大型花牌廣為宣揚，花牌店越來越少，只因找傳人甚難！走訪元朗花牌店第三代傳人，花牌紥作如何為他帶來滿足感？

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈獻：唱錢粵
programme.desc: 曾被《唱錢》系統擊敗的八位復仇者重新集結，力求大逆襲！Sing盤上每一格對應一位復仇者昔日落敗之歌，挑戰成功之人才可取得獎金入場券。每當唱完一條線，由小肥、黃洛妍、女團XiX成員、「爆機」素人Mani組成的Sing級唱將聯盟，就會派出一人迎戰Monster，通關即累積獎金池，最終復仇成功者可均分獎金！觀眾只需用手機掃描螢幕上的QR Code，即可參與直播室互動，為挑戰者打氣，更有機會贏取福利。

programme.title: 伯樂音樂學院20週年呈獻：J Music粵
programme.desc: 同樣喜愛創作的周吉佩與張馳豪合唱<玻璃，其後受訪才知二人有同樣的作曲「最佳時刻」！他們亦分別送上自家作曲的新歌<單眼皮與大眼睛與<樂活道。另邊廂，張與辰創作<迷戀有害，是想跳出悲慘情歌的框框？許文軒倒數本週「勁歌金榜」，也邀來葉麗儀、陳潔靈、Johnny Yim暢談以場館為主角的靚聲演唱會細節。Honey Punch其中四位成員聯同主持柯雨霏「霏」到韓國練舞、歎美食，更拍攝合照來造鎖匙扣。

programme.title: 風味人間 第2季粵
programme.desc: 十月，中國東北民眾由採收的馬鈴薯提取澱粉，經過加工製成粉條，成為吸收菜式醬汁的佳配食材。另外，山藥煮熟後口感軟糯，味道清淡。因其可塑性高，適合烹調成多樣化的鹹甜美食。秘魯帕魯帕魯海拔四千五百米的高山上，印第安人世代種植馬鈴薯，作為日常主食，還沿用古老技法加工為凍乾薯仔，延長保質期。法國萊茵河西岸盛產白蘆筍，採收要在夜間進行，並需於三小時內烹調，方能保留最佳滋味；每逢收成，吸引歐洲各地饕客慕名而至。

programme.title: 香港賽馬會特約：J Sport粵
programme.desc: 一眾長跑好手齊集跑步機慈善賽，以接力形式挑戰跑步極限，精英組、企業組、學界賽等戰況如何？無人機足球公開賽召集多地隊伍展開較量，香港一隊以主場之利獲得亞軍。青少年三人籃球賽設有男、女子組賽事，中國前籃球代表亦落場參與表演賽。香港運動節透過匹克球、桌上排球等不同體驗區，讓市民感受新興運動的樂趣。港超聯正式開鑼，這集搜羅首週足球比拼精華。另帶來亞洲快棋超快棋國際象棋錦標賽戰報、高爾夫球精英賽記招花絮。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
廉政狙擊#26粵PG
programme.desc: 屠敏在家晴死後大受打擊，放棄商戰計劃，轉用激進方法綁架卓家四人，並在網絡直播，把廷光的惡行公諸於世。子峰、曉山及時趕到，阻止屠敏殺害廷光；糾纏間不慎啟動炸彈計時器，結果子峰、屠敏和廷光都被埋在瓦礫下…

programme.title: 胡說八道真情假期粵
programme.desc: 出埠旅行最能了解好友的真性情，「胡說八道會」六位姊妹結伴暢遊澳洲兩個星期，盡顯真我一面。準媽媽胡杏兒貪玩「唔錫身」，姚子羚對姊妹最有心！胡定欣性感又感性，李施嬅衣著品味夠獨特。胡蓓蔚說話有幾Mean？黃智雯轉數有多慢？今集逐一預覽。旅行籌備過程一波三折，智雯更於出發前鬧出「放飛機」疑雲！姊妹們抵澳後進駐景色優美的湖畔酒店，透過按摩、水療消除疲勞。智雯為杏兒悉心編排「大乳操」，眾女還即席集體演練！

programme.title: 香港婚後事粵PG
programme.desc: 家事不宜擺上枱，但吳若希向來敢言，其實丈夫可有投訴？若希細談互相鬥嘴的婚姻相處模式，還直言擺上網是想網友幫忙教夫。夫妻生活節奏不同，要花不少時間磨合，若希亦稱最討厭丈夫為小事講大話。走過七年之癢，若希坦言多得參演了《香港人在北京》？生B後繼續發展個人事業，她既感謝丈夫支持，也希望為兩子女做個榜樣。要避免伴侶出軌，維繫關係比管制有效？若希也講述某人妻為報復丈夫，搭上他的好友後發現「外面世界很大」……

programme.title: 香港婚後事粵PG
programme.desc: 當婚姻關係無法挽回，離婚在所難免，這集請來龔慈恩探討現今女性對離婚看法。龔姐經歷過兩段婚姻，坦言若遇合適對象仍會考慮。談到子女將來成家立室，龔姐會是怎樣的奶奶、外母？家庭離異會對下一代造成傷害，離婚父母要好好處理！單親長大的天宇獲母親濃濃的愛，也和同母異父弟弟胡㻗感情深厚，唯獨介懷身高不及對方？此外，諾懿指導天宇煎牛扒，平價食材煮出貴價口感！在職媽媽總有不少辛酸，慰玲難忘拍劇時兩次遇上仔仔入醫院。

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 巴基斯坦的木爾坦, 南亞最古老的城市。陪伴木爾坦人穿越沙漠的駱駝對他們來說是很珍貴的存在 死後的駱駝更被製作成駱駝皮燈，再畫上傳統的納卡什圖案，為木爾坦人照亮黑暗的盡頭

programme.title: 世界獨特社區粵普
programme.desc: 越南筒房是因人口暴漲，搶奪居住空間所衍生出的獨特建築風格。房間建築空間狹長而深，巧妙避開了以橫向寬度的高稅收。丹麥社區農圃, 提供一種糧食自給, 互助和合作的生活方式, 試圖打破都市住民彼此間的隔閡。

programme.title: 細味文明粵英
programme.desc: 兩座巨型火山從愛琴海冒起，繼而出現兩個壯觀島嶼：聖托里尼和米洛斯。山峰倒塌形成破火山口，令聖托里尼展現超凡地貌，一個個小鎮屹立於崖頂，而曾是海盜天堂的米洛斯島亦充滿原始美。

programme.desc: 怪物獵人們回來啦！他們將再度將平凡的生活搞得天翻地覆，讓無聊的日子變成充滿怪物、魔法和混亂的瘋狂大冒險！前兩季已經夠奇怪了？接下來還會變得更妙更奇怪，千萬別錯過！

programme.title: 超級總動員S22
programme.desc: 全新場景、全新比賽陣容、全新遊戲並結合世界各國的場景與關卡。考驗麻吉好友和團體的合作默契，一場場歡笑、緊張與刺激的團體競賽，陪伴大朋友小朋友週末的歡聚時光。

programme.title: 能成為陌生人嗎
programme.desc: 【姜素拉化身訴訟女神離婚怨偶再擦出火花】所謂「相愛容易，相處難」，恩範&荷拉已愛情長跑10年、結婚3年，因男方外遇出軌導致離婚收場。專門負責離婚訴訟的明星律師吳荷拉，時常上電視節目，大談如何應對離異後的謠言誹謗、前夫不負責閃避贍養費等問題，對她來說前夫只是「行走的贍養費」。原本自己開設事務所的恩範，因打輸官司被客戶追著跑，窮途末路下找到荷拉就職事務所的代表，簽下聘用合約。面對「最熟悉的陌生人」前夫恩範，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快樂地過著婚後人生呢？這對歡喜冤家又會擦出什麼火花呢？

programme.title: 陷入純情(完)
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: 青春時代
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，寫下青春紀事！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，個性、人生目標和對男人的品味皆不相同。會有意見不合、吵架的時候，但隨著時間相處，築起溫暖的友情、像家人一樣的相處。同住一個屋簷下，寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 青春時代
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，寫下青春紀事！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，個性、人生目標和對男人的品味皆不相同。會有意見不合、吵架的時候，但隨著時間相處，築起溫暖的友情、像家人一樣的相處。同住一個屋簷下，寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，共度後青春時代！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，同住一個屋簷又過了一年，迎來了新的室友。臨近大學畢業的日子，求職與愛情的煩惱，五個追著自己期望的事物，繼續寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.title: 韶華若錦(完)
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 粉紅色口紅
programme.desc: 【朴恩惠經典復仇之作好閨密為渣男反目成仇】因做錯抉擇導致人生本末倒置的女人，經過4次婚姻終於找到真愛與幸福的故事。柳佳恩把初戀情人當成全部，放棄了自己的夢想，卻得到徹頭徹尾的背叛。她的第一任丈夫朴正宇，圖謀佳恩家的財富和地位與佳恩結婚，在達到目的後將佳恩拋棄，轉而和情人美蘭結婚，陰謀奪得了佳恩父親的公司，並間接害死了佳恩的父親。在如此深仇大恨面前，佳恩一步步從一位百合般純潔的女人，變成了帶刺的玫瑰。

programme.title: 沒關係，是一家人
programme.desc: 【母親宣布「卒婚」引發家庭風暴父親失憶揭露大女兒身世秘密】故事圍繞著一對老年夫婦和他們的三名成年子女展開。母親突然宣佈要「卒婚」，因厭倦與脾氣火爆的父親同居，父親則因委屈一度想輕生，卻失敗導致失憶回到22歲，意外揭露大女兒並非親生的秘密。大女兒恩珠發現丈夫是同性戀，內心崩潰，而二女兒恩熙則陷入了複雜的感情糾葛中，被劈腿後又成了上司的情人。小兒子智宇無意中知曉了家族的深藏秘密。「像外人一樣的家人」間產生誤會，不斷磨合理解的家庭劇。

programme.title: 陌生人
programme.desc: 【MOD首播】【怪力媽搭配毒舌女母女笑鬧同居火花不斷】一個是凡事衝動、毫無對策的媽媽，一個是灑脫率性、走自己路的女兒。原本就像陌生人一樣的母女，被迫住在同一屋簷下，雞飛狗跳成為日常。從降職的糗事、誤會的桃色風波，到接連不斷的麻煩事件，她們在鬥嘴中暗暗守護彼此。越是嫌棄對方，越是離不開對方——這場「陌生人同居記」，意外寫下母女間最爆笑、最暖心的篇章。

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 歐若拉公主

programme.title: 向風而行
programme.desc: 【《請叫我總監》譚松韻與《清平樂》王凱，飛向天際攜手築夢！！】鷺洲航空客運飛行部副部長顧南亭因公司改制，與性格颯爽不羈的程霄成為上下屬和師徒關係。面對接踵而來的突發航空事件，追求穩定秩序的顧南亭時常被不按常理出牌的程霄打亂計劃，共同經歷衝擊與考驗，一路披荊斬棘、相扶成長。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 行動電源出發吧
programme.desc: 【不插電的戶外實境節目，重新找回心的連結！！】充滿冒險與成長的戶外實境節目，由侯彥西、陳妤帶領一群新人演員，拋開日常科技，踏上從「心」出發的旅程。山林間的挑戰、露營體驗等，讓成員彼此扶持坦誠交流，重新找回與人相處的真實感動。每一次困難互助，都化作心靈的充電，讓旅行不只是冒險，更是成長與情感的累積，他們成為彼此的「行動電源」，燃亮內心最真摯的力量與溫暖。

programme.title: Remember-兒子的戰爭
programme.desc: 【俞承豪為父申冤，朴敏英成為他正義路上的唯一靠山！！】徐振宇擁有過目不忘的記憶力，為了替被誣陷為殺人犯的父親申冤成為了律師，與權勢貪腐正面對抗。與堅守正義的檢察官李仁雅，從質疑到並肩作戰，成為振宇最堅強的後盾。就在逐步逼近真相時，卻發現自己正逐漸失去記憶。他們攜手在權力夾縫中拚搏，在時間與遺忘賽跑，只為守護真相與心中那份信念與愛。

programme.title: 水龍吟
programme.desc: 【羅雲熙尋找弒師真相的亡命追途，改寫江湖的命運！！】十年前，唐儷辭親眼目睹師門覆滅，卻被誣陷成弒師兇手，從天之驕子淪為人人喊打的罪人背負沉冤，只為查清那場血案背後真正的黑手。多年後，他帶著刻入骨血的信念重返江湖。為尋找真相，潛入暗勢力盤踞的「十三樓」，捲入武林與朝野交織的陰謀；與此同時，他結識池雲、鍾春髻等真心相伴之人，也在危機四伏的旅途中重新學會信任與牽掛。

programme.desc: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - El castillo de Robins
programme.desc: Como la lente no se puede recuperar, el Dr. No quiere fabricar otra, pero necesita petirrojos para ello. Así que ataca Rubidia, una región repleta de piedras preciosas. Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. Pero el chico atrapa al científico y también ayuda a liberar a los esclavos de Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La trampa de la armonica
programme.desc: Chip y sus amigos crean una zona con formaciones que se asemejan a instrumentos musicales y armonizan sus sonidos. De repente, quedan atrapados en un rectángulo de cristales de cuarzo que vibran al formar una trampa sónica. Un átomo músico, que los ha capturado, busca miembros para formar una orquesta. Los antimateriales están cerca y Chip le pide al músico que prepare la trampa para retenerlos y escapar. El músico acepta y los antimateriales se convierten en prisioneros, obligándolos a escuchar el terrible sonido de sus composiciones.

programme.desc: In 1913 Denmark, young officer Anton grapples with duty and love when he befriends Baron von Løvenskjold's daughter, Edith, confined to a wheelchair. As their bond deepens, Anton is ensnared in a web of promises and lies, torn between pity and true love.

programme.title: Games People Play

programme.title: Yakka Dee S01 - Bus
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say bus and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different buses - red, double-decker and bendy! We see Dee waiting for the bus, and driving a bus in a picture on the wall. Everyone goes 'all aboard!' a bus and we even see an elephant getting into a bus! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today's word!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S01 - Tick Tock Messy
programme.desc: Messy goes to OKIDO to play with Zim and Zam's new discovery, but will he and his friends get back from this adventure in time?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - The Way of the Woods
programme.desc: A camping trip with Preston goes very wrong when he won't let them use Mojo's tops. But camping Preston's way soon starts a fire. It's Mojo and Bo to the rescue!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Wild Girls
programme.desc: Coco wants to play Wild Girls with Indy, but Chloe wants her to play another game.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Dragon
programme.desc: When Bluey needs some assistance drawing a dragon for a story she is working on, she asks her dad, Bandit, for help.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Mime Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming. They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through the basics.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Talent Badge
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - it's King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part. First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that 'finding their talents' means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Splash Dash
programme.desc: Duggie chooses a key and his blue digger to dig up a big bone. The chipmunk makes a delivery to the squirrels.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Mystery Seeds
programme.desc: When Duggee finds some seeds it's time for some gardening!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Christmas Island, Indian Ocean
programme.desc: Grand Master Glitch travels with his Grimbots to Christmas Island in the Indian Ocean in the hope of finding some festive cheer, even though it's not Christmas Day. He is sorely disappointed when he finds himself on a tropical island with not a hint of Christmas in sight! Determined to have his Christmas Day, he sets about trying to spread his own festive cheer by covering the island in snow. But this means the island's Red Land Crabs can't get to the ocean to lay their eggs. As the crabs are in

programme.title: Bluey S01 - The Dump
programme.desc: On a trip to the Dump, Dad claims he's the best at everything. But Bluey discovers that Dad's throwing out her old drawing and questions if he really is the best Dad in the world.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Mr Monkeyjocks
programme.desc: Dad thinks the kids have too many toys and suggests a chuck out. To save their beloved Mr Monkeyjocks from getting the chop, Bluey and Bingo must prove he is special.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Magic
programme.desc: Bluey teaches Bingo how to use magic so she can make Mum play with her, but she forgets to explain the most important rule: never use magic for cheekiness.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Chest
programme.desc: Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Prehistoric Picnic
programme.desc: Andy meets some peckish Pachycephalosaurus, a hungry T-rex and a pterosaur.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Snail
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Fortress of Fun, where Kingsley and Queenie have a snail slime race. But who will win, Team King or Team Queen?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Choreography Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are out doing their exercises when suddenly, a cheetah called Chipo comes along with his dance crew. He criticises them for not being able to dance in time, and it turns out Duggee used to be part of the dance crew! Duggee was a great dancer, but he never stuck to the choreography and was always making up his own moves.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - Betty's First Day
programme.desc: The Squirrels are having fun playing games but are surprised to find out that Betty didn't always enjoy playing. Since her first day at Squirrel Club, she always impressed everyone with her confidence and independence, but at first she didn't know how to join in with the others. Luckily, Duggee had a great idea to bring all the Squirrels together.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Hat Badge
programme.desc: King Tiger interrupts the Squirrels' quiet time when he turns up to the Clubhouse with a magic hat on instead of his crown.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Forbidden City, China
programme.desc: What is that awful noise coming from the Gulou Tower? It's Grandmaster Glitch dressed up as a Chinese Emperor singing of course! Go Jetters to the rescue!

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Dead Sea, Middle East
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are relaxing by the Dead Sea when Grandmaster Glitch causes a custard catastrophe - to the Vroomster!

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - First Day on Sodor!
programme.desc: Darcy the tunnel boring machine makes some mistakes on her first day, but she soon makes up for it when everyone sees what she can really do.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S02 - Star Renovation
programme.desc: Venus has attempted to redecorate the night sky, but now Sarah can't find any of her favourite constellations...

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S02 - Woolly Memories
programme.desc: Scarf Lady's old film reels get themselves in a tangle, so Sarah and Duck decide to recreate the footage.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Recycling
programme.desc: Fred, Fifi and Ari call Stanley to help them with their recycling drive by coming up with a way of repurposing all the towns' old stuff. Stanley makes a crazy golf course!

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Seaside
programme.desc: Myrtle, Sophie and Benjamin call Stanley to teach them how to make a sandcastle. Myrtle asks for a bigger one, so big it turns into a sandcastle resort!

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - I Ate My House
programme.desc: The talking animals chat about all the fun stuff about where they live.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S03 - Mother's Day
programme.desc: JoJo, Gran Gran, Mummy and Great-Gran-Gran have a special day ahead of them to celebrate Mother's Day. Together, the four generations of JoJo's family have a relaxing spa day at home. Daddy helps JoJo surprise Mummy with a special meal, Gran Gran sends Great-Gran-Gran a card, and Mummy gives Gran Gran a special blanket. JoJo had forgotten that Gran Gran is Mummy's mummy!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Exercise
programme.desc: Dad thinks he needs to do some exercise, but Bingo pretends to be Boss Bluey's new employee in the middle of Dad's backyard workout.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Relax
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo would rather explore their holiday hotel room than relax on the beach.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Stickbird
programme.desc: On a trip to the beach, Mum teaches Bluey to throw, while Bingo and Dad get creative with a funny shaped stick.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Dos and Don'ts Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are causing a bit too much mess in the clubhouse, so Duggee explains that they need to think more carefully about what they are doing.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Exercise Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels set off on a warm-up run together. The Squirrels are feeling sleepy, but they are told that a bit of exercise will wake them up!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - El Gran Final
programme.desc: Join the chickens in space for the big finale of Agony and Eggstacy! Mucho Suspense!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - The Matterhorn, Italy and Switzerland
programme.desc: Meet the Go Jetters, four explorers on a global adventure! Glitch gets into a mountain of trouble as the Go Jetters climb the Matterhorn.

programme.desc: Raspberry sings a song, saying it's cool to be kind.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Pineapple
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the magical Pineapple attempting to perform a very difficult magic trick with the help of Kiwi.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Sheep Dog
programme.desc: Dad agrees to play Sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum who is taking a well-earned rest, but looking after a sheep is harder work than they expected.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Housework
programme.desc: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Pass the Parcel
programme.desc: Lucky's Dad is outraged that modern Pass the Parcel has a present in every layer and changes the rules back to only having one prize in the middle, but Bingo is forever losing.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Perfect
programme.desc: For her Father's Day card, Bluey sets out to draw a picture of herself and her father together. While recalling her favourite memories of playing with Bandit, Bluey struggles with the idea that her drawing must be perfect. Chilli tries to convince Bluey that perfection isn't easy, or absolutely necessary.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Explorers
programme.desc: While waiting to be picked up from school, Jack plays at being a sailor trying to find his way back home to Australia. Meanwhile, Jack's Dad has got lost on route to collect him.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S24 - Kenji on the Rails Again
programme.desc: When Kenji hears that he must travel home to Japan alone, he gets scared and tries to hide. So, Thomas sets out to find him

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S24 - Cleo the Road Engine
programme.desc: In an attempt to beat Thomas in a race, Cleo decides to use the railway lines instead of the road. She soon learns that the roads are much safer for a little car.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S24 - Nia's Bright Idea
programme.desc: Nia uses what she learns about lighthouses to suggest covering a big wheel in Christmas lights, so that Harold can see where he's going in a storm.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Mariana Trench: The Pacific Ocean
programme.desc: With the help of his hero Ron Allum, Lars plans to dive to the bottom of the Mariana Trench in a submersible called the Deep Sea Challenger. Glitch plans to beat him there by sending a Grimbot in his Grimsub, but it can't withstand the heavy pressure of the water. Lars and Xuli must work together to mount a rescue operation at the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Svalbard Global Seed Vault, Norway
programme.desc: Ubercorn and Glitch head to the Svalbard Global Seed Vault. But, just like when they were cadets together, the two of them get into trouble. Glitch accidentally crashes the Grimbler into the vault.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Shopping Shenanigans, Istanbul, Turkey
programme.desc: In Istanbul's Grand Bazaar, Glitch wishes he could buy everything. Hearing about the wishes granted by the Hen's Eye Column in an underground water store, the Basilica Cistern, Glitch heads beneath the earth and brings the entire cistern close to collapse!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Cliffhanger
programme.desc: Felix the pig is stuck on a cliff ledge where not even Mojo's tops can reach him. They will need to be creative to get Bo up there and save that poor pig!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - The Swoppiton Duck
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo need Ted's help to pull a wobbly duck statue up Swoppiton Hill. But does Ted know the best way? And will there be anything left of the duck when they get there?

programme.title: Supertato S02 - The Evil Peamobile
programme.desc: Evil Pea builds her own Evil Peamobile - and it has more gadgets than the Tatocar! It's Carrot's job to make the Tatocar even better before the two cars to go head-to-head.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Runner Bean
programme.desc: Supertato and Runner Bean are competing for first place in this year's supermarket race, but Evil Pea has plans to win by cheating.

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01 - Hench Cobs Song
programme.desc: It's tough being one of Evil Pea's hench cobs, so Corn and Cob have a song to tell us all about it.

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01 - Evil Pea's Freeze Dance Song
programme.desc: Evil Pea has created her very on Freeze Dance song to trick the fruit and veggies into dancing with her, so she can freeze them for real!

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01 - Tatocar vs Evil Peamobile Song
programme.desc: The Tatoteam have the Tatocar and Evil Pea has the Evil Peamobile. But which one of these machines is best? Carrot and Evil Pea have a song to decide.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Water Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels learn all about where water comes from, and their journey takes them from the sea and back to the kitchen sink and another drink of water. Wow! Water is amazing!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Traffic Badge
programme.desc: It's a hot day so Duggee is treating the Squirrels to a trip to the tropical lake. It's particularly busy out today and there's a traffic jam! Thank goodness Duggee has his traffic badge. He knows what to do!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Dressing Up Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is wrapping a present because it is Enid's birthday. But the squirrels didn't get her anything! Maybe they could give her a surprise...but Enid doesn't like surprises. Norrie suggests dressing up, what a great idea!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Getting On Badge
programme.desc: When the squirrels upset the mole by being noisy, Duggee suggests ways that they can all live underground peacefully.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - El Gran Final
programme.desc: Join the chickens in space for the big finale of Agony and Eggstacy! Mucho Suspense!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Night And Day
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered what goes on at the Squirrel Club when the sun goes down?

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Say Cheese
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn about butterflies and tortoises.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Eugene's Animal Chorus
programme.desc: Eugene gives an unexpected performance with help from some talented animals! Mooo!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Copy The King
programme.desc: The Squirrels play Copy the King!

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Favourite Thing
programme.desc: When Bluey accidentally makes Bingo upset playing a game at dinner, she will do anything to make her happy again - even changing the rules of the game. But nothing seems to work.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Daddy Dropoff
programme.desc: Dad refuses to be late dropping off Bluey and Bingo at kindy and school, but the girls make Dad play so many games, they quickly derail his plan.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Bingo
programme.desc: When Bluey has a playdate at Chloe's, Bingo must learn how to play by herself. But all the games she knows need more than one person! Luckily Dad has a problem that needs solving.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Rug Island
programme.desc: On Bingo and Bluey's Rug Island, a pack of felt pens can be anything: bananas, campfires, even a snake. But Dad will need to embrace his inner kid if he wants to make it his home.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures S01 - Andy and the European Hamster
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout jet off in the Explorer to Vienna, Austria, on a global adventure to solve the mystery of an animal behaving strangely in a churchyard. Along the way, Andy meets a wild European hamster with a taste for flowers and candle wax.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures S01 - Andy and the Pallas's Cats
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout embark on a global adventure to Mongolia in eastern Asia to uncover the mystery of moving rocks, only to discover it's a mother Pallas's cat out hunting for her kittens. Along the way, Andy takes a ride with a Bactrian camel.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Talent Badge
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - it's King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part. First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that 'finding their talents' means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Mime Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming. They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through the basics.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Why Badge
programme.desc: All the Squirrels are having a fine old time playing with the hose. All except one, poor Tag whose feet hurt. 'Why do my feet hurt?', he asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them 'why' is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Sibling Badge
programme.desc: It's news time at the Clubhouse, and the Squirrels share their exciting news of the week with each other. Happy got a new bath sponge, Norrie is growing a sunflower and Roly, after thinking hard if he's got any news at all, remembers he's getting a new brother or sister. The Squirrels have all sorts of questions to ask.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Monster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing outside, when out of a bush jumps the cutest creature they ever did see. They think it is simply adorable and tell it so... with startling results. The creature bursts into tears! The creature, whose name is Plinky, tells them her whole family are monsters, and that's what she's supposed to be, but she just cannot get the hang of it. The Squirrels are keen to help Plinky get in touch with her scary side. Fortunately, Duggee has his monster badge.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Rug Island
programme.desc: On Bingo and Bluey's Rug Island, a pack of felt pens can be anything: bananas, campfires, even a snake. But Dad will need to embrace his inner kid if he wants to make it his home.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures S01 - Andy and the European Hamster
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout jet off in the Explorer to Vienna, Austria, on a global adventure to solve the mystery of an animal behaving strangely in a churchyard. Along the way, Andy meets a wild European hamster with a taste for flowers and candle wax.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures S01 - Andy and the Pallas's Cats
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout embark on a global adventure to Mongolia in eastern Asia to uncover the mystery of moving rocks, only to discover it's a mother Pallas's cat out hunting for her kittens. Along the way, Andy takes a ride with a Bactrian camel.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Talent Badge
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - it's King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part. First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that 'finding their talents' means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xu's until her long lost mother appears one day and to make her happy, Mrs Xu reluctantly lets the girl reunite with her mother.

programme.title: The Magic Blade
programme.desc: The movie depicts Fu Hong Xue fighting against the formidable conspirator Master Yu and seeing through his deception. The brilliantly choreographed fights, glorious settings, superb cinematography and strong casts define this movie as a highpoint in Wu Xia cinema.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: It's a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: Four Riders
programme.desc: Four martial arts experts live in Seoul after the Korean War in the 1950s. One of them inexplicably crosses path with a drug trafficking syndicate, and his three friends have no choice but to fight a brutal battle on his side...

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperor's plot once again.

programme.title: Little Hero
programme.desc: An orphan, Little Bastard is taken on and trained as a fighter by a hermit. When Little Bastard grows up, he feels he is old enough to go out and look for his parents. Luckily for him, he befriends a beggar, Hsiao Yi, who being street-wise, manages to help him find his family, but somehow gets into trouble with the gang.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to attend school and falls in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After discovering her true identity, Shan Bo proposes marriage, only to learn that Ying Tai has been promised to another man. Forced apart, Shan Bo dies in despair. Devastated by the news, Ying Tai kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he decides to help the peasants and gain a reputation of being a great pirate in the process.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 3
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong go to Iron Palm Peak to search for the Book of Wumu. The chief of Iron Palm discovers their visit, and seriously injures Huang. It seems only the Southern Emperor Duan can heal her, but will Huang be healed in time?

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Yang Gui Fei is the beloved concubine of Emperor Tang Ming Huang, who is so besotted with her that he leaves the running of the country to Prime Minister Yang Guo Zhong, the brother of Yang Gui Fei. The Prime Minister is corrupt and cruel to the army, causing them to revolt and endanger the throne. Yang Gui Fei is also implicated and kills herself.

programme.title: Descendant of the Sun
programme.desc: Shi Sheng is adopted by an old carpenter and grows up to possess extraordinary superpowers. One day, he unexpectedly discovers his identity as the son of the solar deity and learns that his power will be lost during solar eclipse. When an evil spirit appears and wreaks havoc, Shi Sheng must beat him in an ultimate duel to save the world.

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiao's fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiao's fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: The Gambling Syndicate
programme.desc: A young provincial detective seeks to take down a local gambling syndicate with the help of two convicts.

programme.title: Intimate Confessions of a Chinese Courtesan
programme.desc: Young Ai Nu is abducted and sold to the popular Four Seasons brothel run by the powerful and ruthless Madam Chun Yi. Ai Nu gets locked up in a dungeon due to her fiery attitude. Soon, a murder occurs within the brothel and a policeman must race against time to prevent a vicious revenge plot from reaching its blood-spattered conclusion.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the group's drummerleader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummer's mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: Shaolin Temple
programme.desc: As more people are learning martial arts from Shaolin, the Qing court orders for it to be banned and plans to destroy the temple. The Shaolin disciples decide to take their protest to the streets, using Shaolin skills to curb their hatred, but when the Qing troops start attacking Shaolin Temple, the disciples vow to protect it at all costs.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers' claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Men From The Monastery
programme.desc: At the end of the Ming Dynasty, Wu San Gui betrays his people by siding with the Qing and recruiting fighters from all backgrounds. Members of the Wudang and Emei sects are among the first to surrender and collude with local bullies. When they attack the Shaolin Monastery, its renowned disciples must unite to fight their enemies.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness &amp;amp; innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: Heaven and Hell
programme.desc: When an angel, Ling, decides to help his two friends who have fallen in love to escape from Heaven, he is sent to live as a human on earth as his punishment. Reincarnated as a cab driver, he sacrifices his own life to save another ill-fated couple and lands in hell, where he has to face off against the ghosts and demons to fight his way out!

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: The Trail of the Broken Blade
programme.desc: After avenging his father's death by assassinating a high official, Li Yue disappears into hiding as a fugitive. His fiancée enlists a swordsman—who secretly loves her—to search for him, unaware that the bandit Xiao Mei has also fallen for Li Yue. Their intertwined love quadrangle explores themes of sacrifice, devotion and selfless love.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a police's son, blames his father for his mother's death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: Full Moon Scimitar
programme.desc: Swordsman Ding fought against many swordsmen and won, so he took his first defeat badly and wanted to commit suicide. It is then that he meets the granddaughter of a mystic Sect leader and falls in love. When they want to get married, the Sect leader presents Ding with the “Full Moon Scimitar”, on the condition that he will never leave the sect.

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty
programme.desc: The Flying Guillotine assassins are secretly working for the Emperor and its leader Jin is sent to kill Hon, who knows this secret. Hon's pregnant wife Rong seeks to kill Jin but retreats to protect her unborn child. When she is hunted down herself, Rong hooks up with a former Flying Guillotine member and her martial arts senior to fight back...

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty
programme.desc: The Flying Guillotine assassins are secretly working for the Emperor and its leader Jin is sent to kill Hon, who knows this secret. Hon's pregnant wife Rong seeks to kill Jin but retreats to protect her unborn child. When she is hunted down herself, Rong hooks up with a former Flying Guillotine member and her martial arts senior to fight back...

programme.title: Invincible Shaolin
programme.desc: An evil Qing general comes up with a plan to rid the Shaolin masters once and for all. He invites three Northern Shaolin experts to fight against three Southern Shaolin disciples. After the contest, the general secretly kills the Southerners and places the blame on the Northerners. This leads to in-fighting between both Shaolin schools.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brother's death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh (Glass Tears, Killer Clans) and Shi Szu (Lovers Destiny), who must fight their way out of trap after trap. But they can't escape them all, and eventually the two end up in prison... it is either death or a fight to the end!

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: The movie consists of four stories of the Mad Monk helping others, from saving a mother and daughter from crumbling walls, to helping hawkers deal with bullies, recovering stolen money for a young man and punishing a devious court official and his son.

programme.title: The Villains
programme.desc: Hung is an orphan seeking help from her wealthy uncle who has two sons but only dotes on the younger son Feng, a playboy. Feng covets the beauty of Hung and rapes her but when she gets pregnant, Hung is wrongfully accused and gets sent off by her uncle to protect Feng. Will Feng be punished for his villainy?

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Chang's. On the Chang's farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: Death Duel
programme.desc: Third Master is a renowned swordsman in the martial arts world, but the constant challenges by other swordsmen compel him to fake his death and pursue a secluded life. This does not prevent others from seeking him out to challenge him however, and he is forced to return to fight his way till the end.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to marry his daughter, forcing Mulan to reveal her true identity.

programme.title: Life Gamble
programme.desc: Martial arts master Yu has retired for years but is invited to join force with another master Tao to fight against the four famous thieves and retrieve the stolen Dragon Jade. However, Tao's real plan is to possess the treasure himself and kills Yu after he defeats the thieves...

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: Promising martial artist Chao Chih Hao leaves home to compete in a prestigious tournament after training under a legendary master. However, when a corrupt rival school hires Japanese fighters to cripple him, Chao endures brutal training to master the deadly “Iron Fist” technique and return for a fierce, bone-crushing battle for justice and glory.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her family's objection, so Hong's maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Wei Chun is a cocky young man sentenced to jail for killing a man in a fight. One day, Wei Chun picks a fight with a seemingly defenseless old man who completely thrashes him! The old man turns out to be the master of monkey style kung fu and as they become friends, he gives Wei Chun half of a medallion that would direct him to hidden secrets.

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: Two Con Men is a wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy in the vein of "Robin Hood" meets "The Sting". Starring Liang Tien as Clever Chan and Chang Ying (who's done over 400 films) as Tricky Ching, it's the age-old competition between a rookie con artist versus the ultimate, experienced flimflam man. It's a game Chen cannot afford to lose, because people's lives - including his own, hang in the balance of good versus evil.
